text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 triggered for inference-service (eu-west) — elevated 5xx rate and high tail latency. Pager ID pger_4571. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference-latency

sanjay: Acked — I'm on primary on-call. Spinning up a war-room and pulling metrics now.

emily: Joining. What are we seeing from the monitors?

sanjay: 5xx ~7% on /v1/text/generate in eu-west, median latency up from 120ms -> ~2s, p95 > 8s. No indicators of data leakage. Suspect proxy/cache pressure after the rollback at 08:50 UTC.

ops-liaison: War room created: https://meet.redwood/warroom/1799999999 — added eng-runtime, infra, support, and oncall. I'm creating the incident Slack channel thread for comms.

pm-aliya: Added product + support to watchers. Any initial customer-facing guidance?

sanjay: Triage plan: 1) restart proxy pods in eu-west (targeted) 2) if no improvement, enable routing-policy fallback to us-east 3) hold for 30m monitoring. Starting restart in ~90s.

emily: I'll tail traces and confirm whether KV cache errors spike during the restart. Preparing a short status page draft below.

[STATUS PAGE DRAFT]
- Incident: Elevated 5xx errors for text-generation in eu-west
- Detected: 2026-03-17 09:12 UTC
- Impact: Some customers in the EU region may experience increased latency and intermittent timeouts on text-generation endpoints. Embeddings and other regions not impacted at this time.
- Mitigation: Targeted restart of proxy fleet underway; routing fallback to us-east ready if required.
- Next update: 15 minutes

sanjay: SGTM — add one line: "No evidence of data exposure."

ops-liaison: Support rotation paged and acknowledged. Support out-of-band template (please keep legal CC if customers ask about data):

[SUPPORT TEMPLATE]
Hi <customer>,
We're investigating elevated errors impacting text generation for EU-based requests. We're actively mitigating and will follow up within 30 minutes with an update. At this time we have no evidence of data exposure.
— Redwood Support

oncall: Restart started on eu-west proxy pods (pods cycling). Estimated completion ~3m.

incident-bot: Update: targeted restart completed. 5xx rate reduced from ~7% -> 1.2%. Latency returning toward normal. Monitoring continues.

sanjay: Looks like restart helped. Routing fallback not required. We'll monitor for 30 minutes, then run a post-incident checklist and schedule RCA. Assigning follow-up owner for RCA and external comms: emily.

pm-aliya: Thanks — I'll queue a customer follow-up if we see any regressions.

emily: I'll take the RCA and draft the post-incident update. Will include timeline, root cause hypothesis, and mitigation plans.

ops-liaison: Closing war room in 10m if stable. Great work, team. :thumbsup:
